title: Percentile Matrix and Stream/Sync Delta Dashboard for Model Routes
creator: Aisha Kumar
comments: 2025-03-01 — Aisha Kumar (creator): Initial ticket created. Goal: surface p50/p95/p99 for every model->route pairing and show a streaming vs non-streaming delta lane. Tie percentiles to SLI windows and provide quick links to traces for slow tails.

2025-03-03 — Jun Park (assignee): Spike complete — prototyped a Grafana panel layout that uses histogram rollups + derived series for stream/non-stream. Found high cardinality when route_tags are combined with model_version; proposed using route + model family as aggregation key to keep query cost manageable.

2025-03-05 — System Design Review: Decided to compute percentile rollups in the metrics pipeline (pre-aggregated histograms) instead of on-the-fly to keep dashboard latency low. Trade-off: more ingestion storage vs faster dashboards; justified because these dashboards are used for on-call diagnostics.

2025-03-06 — PR feedback (SRE): Request to add a tracelink column that attaches a pre-filtered trace search URL (trace duration > p95 threshold) so an on-caller can jump to relevant traces. Added to next PR.

2025-03-08 — Engineering note: Implemented streaming flag propagation in request logs and trace context. Need a small change in the frontdoor to annotate requests with io_mode=stream|sync. Related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontdoor/pull/273

2025-03-09 — Metrics team (review): Adjusted percentiles windowing to support rolling 5m/1h/24h. Confirmed histogram buckets and exemplars are present for quantile reconstruction. Action: update metrics-protos to include "io_mode" label on percentile metrics. Linked commit: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/metrics-protos/commit/3a7b9

2025-03-11 — UX review (PM + Design): Requested a compact "delta lane" visualization that highlights p95 delta (stream - sync) and color-codes by severity. Also asked for an annotation strip for recent deploys to help correlate regressions with rollouts.

2025-03-12 — Current status (Jun): Dashboard panels implemented in draft Grafana (link above). Backend aggregation work merged (platform PR #4567). Remaining: add deploy annotations, wire alert rules for p95 regression (>20% increase baseline), and finalize runbook entries.

Next steps: (1) Add deploy annotations + release tags to Grafana; (2) Pilot dashboard with two product teams for two weeks; (3) Add automated alerting playbook and link to runbook in dashboard; (4) Rollout to default observability board for SREs.

Related incidents: ENG-24671 highlighted a missing stream flag causing misleading aggregation during an oncall. This ticket includes the fix and additional dashboard guardrails to avoid repeated confusion.
